## About
Maverick Motors Service is the service department at Maverick Motors on S Stemmons Fwy in Lewisville. We handle all repairs and upgrades, and our team will treat your vehicle like one of our own.
Bring in your car for scheduled maintenance, or bring in your truck or SUV when you want a lift, new wheels and tires, custom bumpers or leather seats. Drivers have rated us 4.5 on Google from 40 reviews.

## Services
- Repairs and upgrades: Brakes, AC, alignment, tune ups, check engine lights and more. We handle all repairs and upgrades.
- Full synthetic oil change: Keep your engine running right with a full synthetic oil change.
- Pre purchase inspections: Have a vehicle looked over before you buy it.
- Lifts and level kits: Lifts for trucks and SUVs, or a level kit if you just want your vehicle riding at the right height.
- Wheel mounting and balancing: Pick a new wheel and tire set for anything from off-roading to racing, and mounting and balancing are free.
- Custom bumpers: Front and rear bumpers made to fit your truck or SUV, with room to add lighting or a winch.
- Cloth to leather seats: Tired of cloth seats? We can switch them to leather.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book service?
A: Give us a call, reserve your spot online or drop by in person.

Q: How soon will I hear back after requesting service online?
A: Fill out the service request form and a service person will be in touch within 24 hours.

Q: What lift brands do you use?
A: We work with a wide variety, including McGaughys, Ready Lift and Zone.
